articles.title: Chicagohenge! When the Sun Lines Up With City Streets
articles.summary: Twice a year, the sun rises and sets exactly in line with east-west streets in Chicago and Denver. Fans call it "Chicagohenge," after England's famous Stonehenge.

articles.title: Planes Frozen on the East Coast: One Broken Wire Grounds Hundreds of Flights
articles.summary: A broken circuit and a cut backup cable forced the FAA to stop flights at big East Coast airports on Monday. Hundreds of flights were delayed or canceled in New York and Philadelphia, right as world leaders arrived for the U.N. meeting.

articles.title: Seven Big Countries Tell Iran: Stop Arming the Houthis in Yemen
articles.summary: A group of seven powerful countries called the G7 says Iran must stop giving weapons to the Houthis in Yemen. The Houthis just took over a key waterway called Bab al-Mandab, and more than 120,000 people have fled their homes.
